description: Fire protection and suppression capabilities are not employed and maintained to protect facilities containing information systems.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing fire detection systems (smoke detectors, heat sensors), lack of fire suppression systems (sprinklers, gas-based suppression), absence of independent energy/power sources for fire protection, inadequate maintenance records, missing inspection reports, and non-compliance with local fire codes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Physical and Environmental Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
